articles.title: PLD Space Investor Selects MIURA 5 to Launch Demo Mission
articles.summary:
Japanese satellite manufacturer Mitsubishi Electric has signed a contract with Spanish rocket builder PLD Space to launch a small satellite aboard the company’s second MIURA 5 test flight. PLD Space announced that it had signed the launch contract on 18 November, describing the agreement as “a new stage in the relationship between the two companies.” […]
